prompt: Each time channel "ops" sends "go", send tug1 from gate_in to wash and back to gate_in. Do this at most 10 times.
why: A message trigger (0041 M6, I6): a run starts when a message arrives. 1.9 has no way to wait for one either (`message_received` is reserved). The bound of 10 is stated; the trigger is what stays out.
